selection_objective: Select at most one static and one regime-conditioned candidate using discovery only; validation and holdout are untouched until selection is frozen.

signal_semantics.inverse_state_up_down: WIN return > 0 and WDO return < 0 at decision horizon
signal_semantics.inverse_state_down_up: WIN return < 0 and WDO return > 0 at decision horizon
signal_semantics.prediction: subsequent return after the decision timestamp, never the contemporaneous move used to define state

candidate_scoring_order: net expectation after applicable frozen costs
tie_break: simpler specification, then shorter lag set, then lexical deterministic order
